name: Behavioral Anomaly Detection
description: Detects anomalous agent behavior by comparing real-time activity against per-agent behavioral baselines.
threat_addressed: A compromised or malfunctioning agent may operate within its authorized scope while exhibiting anomalous behavior: unusual tool call patterns, data access volume spikes, rapid action sequences, or purpose-inconsistent actions. Without behavioral baselines, these deviations go undetected.
enforcement_mechanism: Per-agent behavioral baselines established from operational history. Real-time monitoring compares current behavior against baselines. Anomalies trigger alerts and investigation before trajectories complete.

security_outcome.pass: Baselines established for all agents (>7 days operational history). Monitoring latency within threshold. Anomaly alerts generated within defined window.
security_outcome.fail: Behavioral anomaly detected — deviation from established baseline.

display_detail: Tracks agent behavior patterns and flags deviations from established baselines. Monitors tool call frequency, diversity, and timing.
remediation_hint_template: Behavioral anomaly detected — agent activity deviates from established baseline. Review recent tool call patterns and verify this activity is expected.
